about.title: About Mayo Creative Chinese
about.subtitle: Smart learning methodologies & creative thinking to elevate your language skills
about.motto_content: “A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step”. We believe that learning Chinese should not just stop at communication or certificate tests, but must become a practical tool that creates value in your career.
about.pillar.hsk_desc: Standardized pathway following HSK 2.0 and NEW 3.0 international standards, updated rapidly, guaranteed output in writing, comprehensively developing 5 skills: Listening, Speaking, Reading, Writing, and Translation.
about.pillar.practical_desc: Pioneering the connection between Chinese and high-demand industries such as Business, Trade, Logistics, and E-commerce.
about.pillar.classroom_desc: Assignments managed through Google Classroom, with detailed grading and individual pronunciation checks.
about.pillar.sessions_desc: The first 2 sessions focus entirely on mastering Pinyin to build a native-like accent foundation.
teachers.title: Our Professional Team
teachers.banner_desc: All MCC teachers graduated from top universities and received Chinese government scholarships.
teachers.subtitle: MCC brings together talented, dedicated teachers graduated from top universities and CSC full scholarship recipients.
teacher.mai.name: Ms. Luu Ngoc Mai
teacher.mai.bio:
Master's student in International Business - Shanghai University of Finance and Economics (SUFE).
• Bachelor's degree with Honors in Business Chinese - Foreign Trade University (FTU).
• Certificate of Pedagogy (2025).
• HSK6 & HSKK Advanced (04/2024).
• Founder of Mayo Creative Chinese (MCC).
• Managed over 100 classes with thousands of graduates from HSK1 to HSK6 levels.
• Admitted to Master's programs at 3 top Chinese universities (985/211) for International Chinese Education (ECNU) and International Business (SUFE & CUFE).
• Awarded CSC Full Scholarship for Master's in International Business at SUFE (Top 1 Chinese Finance & Economics University by Shanghai Ranking 2023).
• Third Prize in the 2024 "Chinese Calligraphy Art - Lanting Gathering" Competition.
• Former intern at Agricultural Bank of China (ABC) Hanoi Branch, Youtai Technology Guangxi, and Dingfeng Law Firm China.
teacher.thao.name: Ms. Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao
teacher.thao.bio:
Bachelor's degree with Honors in Business Chinese & dual degree in International Economics - Foreign Trade University (FTU).
• Co-founder of Mayo Creative Chinese (MCC).
• Certificate of Pedagogy (2025).
• HSK6 & HSKK Advanced (2023).
• Over 3 years of experience tutoring and preparing students for HSK exams, guiding thousands of students through HSK3-5.
• Over 2 years of teaching experience at online and offline Chinese centers in Hanoi.
• Over 1 year of experience working in logistics and trade with Chinese partners.
• Enthusiastic, attentive, and popular for an engaging teaching style and fun classroom atmosphere.
teacher.ly.name: Ms. Nguyen Huong Ly
teacher.ly.bio:
Bachelor's degree with Honors in International Economics (Chinese major) - Foreign Trade University (FTU).
• Admitted to Master's program in International Chinese Education at Anhui University.
• Certificate of Pedagogy (2025).
• HSK6 & HSKK Advanced (2025), HSK5 (2021) & HSK4 (2020).
• Valedictorian of Chinese Language in Lang Son Province (2021) with a perfect score of 10/10.
• GPA 3.6, scoring maximum grade in all 7 Chinese course modules at FTU.
• Over 4 years of tutoring and teaching experience for high school and university students.
• Over 1 year of experience teaching Vietnamese to Chinese speakers.
• Sourcing & TikTok Operations Intern at Quan Phong Trading and Services Co., Ltd.
teacher.dung.name: Ms. Nguyen Kieu Dung
teacher.dung.bio:
Master's student in International Chinese Education - Anhui University under CSC Full Scholarship.
• Bachelor's degree with Honors in Chinese Language & Culture - University of Languages and International Studies (ULIS-VNU).
• Certificate of Pedagogy (2025).
• HSK6, HSKK Advanced (2024), and CTCSOL (International Chinese Language Teacher Certificate).
• Valedictorian of Chinese Language in Nghe An Province (2021) with a perfect score of 10/10.
• Awarded Third Prize in the 2022 "Vietnam-China Cultural Beauty" video competition and Most Impressive Speaker in RIBA's "Chinese Dream" storytelling contest.
• Over 5 years of tutoring and teaching experience across HSK1 to HSK5 levels.
• 2 years of experience assisting Professors and Lecturers at ULIS.
teacher.linh.name: Tutor Tran Thi Khanh Linh
teacher.linh.bio:
Bachelor's degree in Business English (High-Quality Program) - Foreign Trade University (FTU).
• Language Proficiency: HSK4 & HSKK Intermediate (277/300, 2025) & IELTS 7.5.
• Over 2 years of experience tutoring, grading, and assisting students from HSK1 to HSK4 levels.
• Enthusiastic and dedicated tutor, committed to supporting MCC students.
• Outstanding student of MCC's first HSK2, HSK3, and HSK4 classes.
teacher.lina.name: Ms. Ly Na (Lina)
teacher.lina.bio:
Master's student in International Chinese Education - Anhui University.
• Graduated with Honors in International Chinese Education from a Project 211 University.
• Holds CTCSOL (International Chinese Language Teacher Certificate) and Mandarin Proficiency Certificate (Grade 2, Level A).
• Recipient of prestigious scholarships: 3x School Outstanding Academic Achievement Scholarship, 2x National Encouragement Scholarship, and 1x Autonomous Region Self-Reliance Scholarship.
• Third Prize in the 2020 "Puyi Award" National Translation Competition for College Students.
• Excellent Award & Most Popular Speaker in the 2019 "Chinese Dream · Thanksgiving Journey" contest.
• Over 5 years of experience teaching and assisting in Chinese and English courses.
• Former intern at Shanghai Yiguoyimin Translation Services Co., Ltd.
teacher.hong.name: Ms. Nguyen Khanh Hong
teacher.hong.bio:
Bachelor's degree in International Communication - Diplomatic Academy of Vietnam (DAV), former Chinese-specialized high school student.
• HSK6 & HSKK Advanced (2025).
• Over 3.5 years of experience in Chinese teaching and translation.
• Interpreter at the state banquet welcoming China's General Secretary and President Xi Jinping (2025).
• Second Prize in the National Chinese Speaking Competition in Da Nang (2024).
• Recipient of the Vietnam-China Friendship Scholarship in 2022 and 2023.
• First Prize in the Provincial Outstanding Student Contest in Chinese (2021).
• Third Prize in the Chinese Bridge Competition (2021).
courses.title: Our Training Programs
courses.subtitle: Customized curricula designed for maximum practical learning efficiency
course.kids.title: Chinese for Children (MOET Curriculum)
course.kids.desc: A pathway designed closely following the Ministry of Education and Training's Chinese textbook curriculum. Helps secondary and high school students build a solid language foundation, develop critical thinking, and achieve high academic scores.
course.communication.title: Practical Chinese Communication
course.communication.desc: The optimal solution designed for busy professionals. A streamlined pathway focusing 80% of class time on Listening & Speaking practice, training quick reflexes for confident real-life application.
course.hsk.title: NEW HSK 3.0 Pathway (HSK 1-9)
course.hsk.desc: A comprehensive training pathway updated to the latest international Chinese proficiency standards. Develops all five skills — Listening, Speaking, Reading, Writing & Translation — equipping students to confidently pursue certifications from foundational to academic levels.
course.hsk.objective: New HSK 1-9 Standardized Outputs, Certification Prep
course.hsk_old.title: Standard HSK 1 - 6 (2.0)
course.hsk_old.desc: Core course providing systematic training from basic to advanced levels. Focuses on equal development of 4 skills for both international certification and practical communication.
course.business.title: Business Chinese
course.business.desc: Designed for working professionals to master office communication, negotiations, emailing, presentations, and direct collaboration with Chinese partners.
course.logistics.title: Logistics & Order Chinese
course.logistics.desc: Specialized course covering terminology, dialogues, and actual workflows in shipping, customs clearance, and sourcing on Taobao/1688.
course.logistics.objective: Sourcing, Customs, Freight Terms, Taobao/1688 negotiation
